metaTitle: MPPT vs PWM Charge Controller Sizing
description: Learn when to use MPPT or PWM charge controllers and how to size amps and input voltage, including cold-weather Voc, with worked RV solar examples.
directAnswer: Use MPPT for arrays above about 200 W or higher-voltage panels, and PWM only for small 12 V systems. Size amps as array watts divided by battery volts times 1.25, and keep cold-weather Voc below the controller's input limit.
